name: Ōtaki (Nagano, Japan)
description: A orange field charged at the centre with the Ōtaki village emblem in white: a stylised angular character like a letter Z.
history: Municipal flag of Ōtaki, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Ōtaki village emblem — a stylised angular character like a letter Z
